ValidationRule.description: Requires a reason when a lead from the weekly lead scan is set to Unqualified. The reason feeds the self-learning loop.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(LeadSource, "Claude Weekly Scan"), ISPICKVAL(Status, "Unqualified"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Reason_unqualified__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Vul een reden in (Reason unqualified). Deze reden gebruikt de leadscan om beter te leren.
